BiblicalUsage: Might is the word, and it measures both a king's strength and a queen's authority. The king of the north sets his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and Esther and Mordecai wrote with all authority to confirm the second letter of Purim.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the weight runs from strength that invades to authority that confirms — and only one of them stands.
